newsitem.title: USA: American General Hospitality buys hotels.
newsitem.headline: American General Hospitality buys hotels.

text.p: American General Hospitality Corp said Monday it has signed contracts or agreements in principle to purchase a portfolio that includes three hotels and an office building for about $128 million.

The three hotels, which have a total of 1,246 rooms, are: the Marriott Galleria/West Loop Hotel in Houston, Texas; the Radisson Twin Towers Hotel in Orlando, Fla.; and the Ramada Limited in Madison, Wis.

The real estate investment trust said it is currently in discussions with Marriott, Hilton, Crowne Plaza, Wyndham and Radisson for repositioning the Orlando hotel, and plans to spend about $25 million over the next 24 months to renovate the Orlando and Houston hotels. The Madison hotel will be converted to a Holiday Inn prior to acquisition by the company, it said.
American General also said it has received a commitment from its credit lenders to increase its revolving credit facility to $300 million from $150 million.
